SUPREME COURT OF SEYCHELLES
Reportable
CO 45/2025
In the matter between:
THE REPUBLIC Prosecution
(Represented by Ms Anissa Hermitte for Mrs D’offay)
and
NEVILLE VALENTIN Accused
(Unrepresented)
Neutral Citation: Rep vs Valentin (CO 45/2025) (22 January 2026)
Before: Adeline J
Summary: Remand on conditional bail.
Heard: 22 January 2026
Delivered: 22 January 2026
______________________________________________________________________________
BAIL CONDITIONS
______________________________________________________________________________
Adeline, J
[1] The prosecution has moved this court , viva voce, for the accused be remanded to bail and
that certain conditions be imposed. The application is granted. The accused is remanded to
bail in the following conditions;
(1) Not to interfere with witnesses, or potential witnesses.
(2) To surrender his passport and travel documents.
(3) Not to commit any similar offence whilst on bail.
(4) To report to the Perseverance police station once a week, every Friday before 6 pm.

Page 2 of 2
(5) To appear in court as and when required to do so.
[2] Breach of either of these conditions will render a revocation of bail, which means that bail
will be revoked and the accused will be remanded in police custody.
Signed, dated and delivered at Ile du Port 22nd January 2026.
____________
Adeline J
